top_signals.title: German military eyes cruise missiles from Covenant, a surprise vendor setting up shop
top_signals.summary: The German military is in talks with Covenant over the company's Anthem cruise missile, the country’s defense ministry said on Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: VinFast’s Founder Hands CEO Role to Son Amid Expansion Push
top_signals.summary: Pham Nhat Quan Anh, chairman of VinFast Auto Ltd., will take over as global chief executive officer of the Vietnamese electric-vehicle maker, replacing his father and billionaire founder Pham Nhat Vuong amid an aggressive international push and growing losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Metaplanet cuts Series 10 stock pool by 41%, plans Hong Kong subsidiary
top_signals.summary: Metaplanet will cut 131.3 million potential shares and form a $1 million Hong Kong subsidiary for trading in Bitcoin, equities and credit products.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Trump's Grid Battery Ban Leaves Developers Guessing
top_signals.summary: The United States is trying to build up its energy storage capacities at a rapid scale. At the same time, it is trying to wean itself off of Chinese battery tech. In many ways, these two goals are in direct opposition to each other. China dominates global supply chains for clean energy tech in general, but especially when it comes to lithium-ion batteries, which power everything from your phone to your car.
